title: Black Panther Bogan
style: Phonk-comedy with dusty cowbell loops, punchy handclaps, sliding sub-bass, and swung beatbox pocket; verse one rides Corey and Michelle trading cheeky patter, verse two brings Ruby and Wesley with kid-chorus antics, chorus snaps to gang shouts and harmony stacks. Taped ad-libs, reverse swooshes, grill-click fills, bright punchy mix with cheeky lo-fi grit., comedy
lyrics:
[Intro]
(Corey)
Ayy, from the west side,
(Michelle)
No worries, mate.
(Ruby)
Hola, hola!
(Wesley)
Yeah, nah, yeah, nah!

[Verse 1]
Corey in the ute, got a snag and a grin
Michelle says, "Oi mate, where you been?"
At the servo line, with a cheeky wink
Bought a flat white and a pink milk drink

Beatbox goes boom, little doof in the chest
Michelle does the shoulders, says "I'm the best"
Corey goes "reckon?" with a larrikin smile
Then he tries a dance and it dies in a pile

[Ruby]
Hee hee, too slow!
[Wesley]
Vamos, go!
(Michelle)
No worries, mate
(Corey)
We still look great

[Chorus]
No worries, mate
No worries, mate
¡Vamos, vamos!
No worries, mate

Sneaky panther step
Quiet as night
No worries, mate
We get it right

[Verse 2]
Ruby in thongs, clapping right on beat
Wesley on the esky, stomping both feet
"Hola, primo!" he shouts to the sky
Then he drops a "mate" with a sideways eye

Michelle brings banter like a paper-cut grin
Corey says "yeah, nah" and then dives right in
At the footy oval, they’re
